why: No major reviewer or authority shows up. The results are niche calculators, sizing guides and brand or retailer blogs. They give watt-hour math by fridge type, but none names a product to buy, with prices, for a weekend RV setup. Volt & Valley comes closest by pointing to the 1kWh class. A page that sizes by fridge type and then gives direct picks with current prices and tested codes would stand out.
